blocks.x: Razer's Iskur V2 X ergonomic gaming chair is a budget model, but at its full price, it feels pretty expensive. Now, at $80 off, it's practically a steal, and it sure is a necessity, with the end of 2026 packed with new game releases. Your back and your tush will both thank you.
Key specs: 152-degree recline | Built-in lumbar support | 21.4" seat base | High-density foam cushions | 2D armrests | Plush fabric finishView Deal
Gaming chairs. We love them, we hate them, and we love to hate them.
But Razer's Iskur V2 X actually scored well in our in-depth review, and trust me, if there's one thing we know how to do here, it's sit on our keisters for all too many hours a day.
Check out all of the best Prime Day PC gaming deals here

As far as Razer goes, this chair is on the budget end of the scale, but this month's Prime Day deals have brought it to a new low. At $219, you're getting yourself a sweet chair that your back will thank you for the next time you forget to stand up for five hours in a row.

And, coming from someone who's bought way too many pseudo-gaming chairs over the years, believe me, you don't want a $100 chair that falls apart in three months. I tried. I really tried. It's just not worth it.
FutureFutureFutureLet's get the important stuff out of the way first: When we've tested the Razer Iskur V2 X, we thought it was comfortable. Does anything else truly matter in a chair?

There's some lumbar support, it's adjustable, and it can recline up to 152 degrees, so if you need a nap between gaming sessions, this chair has got you sorted. (You can even nap during games, but your teammates might not love that.)
Beyond the comfy factor, we liked that this chair was breathable, so there'll be no sticky situations in the summer, and putting it together was way less of a pain than one might think.

Aesthetic-wise, if you've seen one Razer product, you've seen them all. The signature black and green with the three-headed snake is an aesthetic that prevails across all of Razer's product lines, including this chair.

But honestly, all things considered, it doesn't scream "gamer" the way some of these chairs like to do. For me, that's a good thing, as I try to pretend I have a life on occasion, so it's nice to have a chair that doubles as an office chair on video calls.

FutureFutureThe end of the year is packed with new releases, from GTA 6 to World of Warcraft Forever. We're all going to be sat on our you-know-what, feeding on snacks and telling our bosses that we have an unfortunate case of the common cold.

And boy, are our backs going to hate us when all is said and done. If nothing else motivates you to get this chair, the thought of spending hours sitting in something uncomfortable should be motivation enough. I know I'm tempted, and my current chair isn't that bad, although it does feel like I'm perched on a wooden bench at times.
So, don't be me. Snap up the Razer Iskur V2 X while Prime Day deals are still on, and then engage full-on hermit mode as soon as it arrives.
